data.name: Fervent: Sovereign Struggle
data.detailed_description:
NOTICE : Game In Development

"Fervent : Sovereign Struggle" is currently being prepared for Demo release. Please follow for more updates.
Current stage of development - Demo Production


About the Game

Fervent: Sovereign Struggle is a dark, story-driven third-person action game set in a world where gods rule over all.

You play as one of O'Millah's Apostles, sent into this world to carry out his Divine Will while he wages war beyond the mortal realm.

Too weak to challenge the gods directly, Apostles must work from the shadows—gathering intelligence, influencing factions, exploiting rivalries, and weakening divine powers from within.

Every decision shapes the balance of power in a world where faith, ambition, and deception collide.

There is no Victory without Sacrifice.  There is no Action without Consequence.

The War of the Gods has begun.

• Become one of O'Millah's Apostles and carry out a divine mission

• Manipulate rival gods through influence, deception, and strategic action

• Explore a dark fantasy world shaped by faith, conflict, and divine politics

• Use stealth, observation, and timing to survive deadly encounters

• Experience a narrated story where choices influence the balance of power

• Discover the hidden truths behind the War of the Gods

• Immerse yourself in atmospheric environments inspired by mythology and religious symbolism

data.short_description: A dark fantasy stealth-action game set in a world ruled by rival gods. You play as one of O'Millah's Apostles, sent to carry out his divine will while he wages war beyond the mortal realm. Apostles must work from the shadows to weaken divine powers from within and await final judgement.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • Storage: 150 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Fervent Sovereign Struggles is a story-driven action-adventure game that features intense violence involving a variety of weapons against both humans and creatures. Some sections of the game include scenes of torture and dismemberment, accompanied by high levels of blood and gore during combat. Crude language and alcohol consumption are prevalent throughout many levels of the game.
